senses.gloss: पिञ्छ, अम्, n. a wing (= पिच्छ).
पिञ्चदेव पिञ्च-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man.

पिञ्ज् पिञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. पिङ्क्ते, पिपिञ्जे,
पिञ्जिता, पिङ्क्तुम्, to tinge, dye, colour
[cf. rt. 1. पिश्]; to sound; to touch; to join [cf. rt.
1. पृच्]; to adore; cl. 10. P. पिञ्जयति, -यितुम्,
to kill, injure; to be strong; to give; to take; to
dwell; to shine; to speak; to emit a sound; [cf.
Lat. ping-ere.]
पिञ्जट, अस्, m. the concrete rheum of the eyes.

पिञ्जन, अम्, n. a bow or bow-shaped instrument
used for cleaning cotton.

पिञ्जर, अस्, आ, अम्, reddish-yellow, yellow or
[]
tawny, of the colour of gold; (अस्), m. tawny-brown
or reddish-yellow colour, a mixture of red and
yellow; a horse (probably a bay or chesnut); N.
of a mountain; (अम्), n. gold; yellow orpiment;
the flower of Mesua Roxburghii; a cage; the ribs
or the cavity formed by them, the thorax; a
skeleton; [cf. पञ्जर.]
—पिञ्जर-ता, f. yellowish-
red (the colour).

पिञ्जरक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga; (अम्), n.
orpiment.
पिञ्जरित, अस्, आ, अम्, coloured reddish-yellow.

पिञ्जल, अस्, आ, अम्, extremely perplexed or con-
founded, disturbed, overcome with terror or grief;
panic-struck, being in great disorder; (आ), f., N. of
a river; (ई), f. two blades of Kuśa grass serving as
an implement to hold certain articles at a sacrifice;
(अम्), n. the leaf of the Kuśa grass; the plant Cur-
cuma Zerumbet (हरिद्राभ); yellow orpiment.

पिञ्जलक, अस्, आ, अम्, in उत्-पिञ्जलक, extremely
confounded or disturbed, being in great disorder.

पिञ्जिका, f. a roll of cotton from which threads
are spun.

पिञ्जूल, अम्, n., Ved. a bundle of stalks, a bundle
of grass, &c.; the wick of a lamp; (sometimes spelt
पिञ्जुल.)

पिञ्जूलक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of his descendants.
पिञ्जूष, अस्, m. the wax of the ear (= पेञ्जूष).

पिञ्जेट, अस्, m. the excretion or concrete rheum
of the eyes; [cf. पिञ्जट.]

पिञ्जोला पिञ्जोला, f. the noise or rustling
of leaves.
